name: decrypt-provider
description: Runtime decrypt/render boundary for protected-content sessions
author: elastos

authority.reason: Validates protected-content decrypt/render session requests and keeps raw CEKs, raw plaintext, filesystem authority, key-backend SDKs, KMS credentials, chain RPC, and wallet RPC out of app capsules.

interfaces.description: Runtime provider affordance descriptors projected from decrypt-provider authority metadata; descriptors are not grants.

methods.description: Request status through the decrypt-provider Runtime provider boundary for elastos://decrypt/*.
Request open session through the decrypt-provider Runtime provider boundary for elastos://decrypt/*.
Request render through the decrypt-provider Runtime provider boundary for elastos://decrypt/*.
